name: Grappled
desc: Held in a martial artist's grip.  The hold ends when its owner moves away, loses the use of both arms, becomes exhausted or the grip expires.

name: Grip Recovery
desc: You need a moment before establishing another grappling grip.

name: Throw Recovery
desc: You need to recover your balance before another throw, even if you change martial arts styles.

name: Drag Recovery
desc: You need to reset your footing before dragging a grappled opponent again.
